title: How Khushi Kapoor Perfected The Art Of Quiet Luxury In A Sage Green Saree | Lifestyle News - News18
text: Amid a season of jewel tones and ornate lehengas, Khushi Kapoor chose restraint over opulence, and the result was quietly captivating. For Anshula Kapoor’s roka celebration, the young starlet stepped into the spotlight wearing a sage and silver Manish Malhotra saree that shimmered delicately with every movement. It was a look that celebrated Indian craftsmanship while embracing the modern sensibility of understated glamour. Khushi Kapoor ’s saree was a study in tonal beauty. The sage-green tissue fabric, gleaming with a gentle metallic sheen, was trimmed with pastel pink and powder-blue embroidery – a subtle interplay of colour that softened the metallic texture. The matching crystal-studded blouse added dimension without tipping into excess, proving that festive dressing can feel light, modern, and timeless all at once. Styled by Tanya Ghavri, the look captured the essence of Manish Malhotra’s evolving design language, where heritage silhouettes meet contemporary restraint. The designer’s signature shimmer was still present, but dialled down to exude elegance rather than extravagance. Where most festive looks lean on heavy jewels or high drama, Khushi took a refined route. Her choice of diamond jewellery from Khanna Jewellers – a slender necklace, dainty earrings, and a statement ring added just the right amount of brilliance. Her makeup was fresh and glowing: softly defined brows, a hint of peach blush, and a beige-pink satin lip that echoed the saree’s pastel accents. The half-up, sleek hairstyle allowed the blouse’s neckline and diamond sparkle to shine through, keeping the overall look harmonious and polished. Khushi’s look is a masterclass in balancing tradition with trend. By opting for lighter tones and minimal embellishment, she showcased how festive fashion can feel effortless yet impactful. The interplay of texture, soft colour, and fine detailing redefined celebration wear for a new generation that prefers subtlety over spectacle. In an era where quiet luxury dominates global runways, Khushi’s saree moment stands out as a perfect Indian interpretation – graceful, grounded, and glowing.
